evidence.section: 3.1 Powder Properties after MA Process in Different Atmospheres
evidence.quote: Despite the particle size difference of MA powder in various atmospheres, PPB pores were rarely observed in all ODS ferritic steels owing to a hot rolling process at 1150 ºC with a final thickness reduction rate to 65%

evidence.quote: According to the Orowan strengthening mechanism, hard dispersoids like Y2O3 are bypassed through the formation of Orowan loops. When this occurred, finer diameter and a higher number density of oxide particles gives higher Orowan stress.
